STRIVE BOOSTS $630M BITCOIN OFFERING: A NEW STEP IN $BTC ACCUMULATION?

Strive (NASDAQ: $ASST) has expanded its $SATS Preferred Stock offering to $630 million, underscoring its commitment to raising capital and growing its treasury.

▪️ 7 million shares priced at $90 each  
▪️ 15% annual dividend on a $100 stated value  
▪️ 16.67% indicative yield at the offering price

₿ A CATALYST FOR TREASURY GROWTH  
Strive currently holds 35,595 BTC. The new capital could help the company increase its Bitcoin reserves significantly. Although the proceeds may be used for other purposes, Bitcoin accumulation appears to be the strategic priority.

Could Strive emerge as a major player in corporate Bitcoin treasuries?

MoonDust Chronicles
